tools.name: get_network_health_solana
tools.description: Returns a 0-100 Solana network health score plus the underlying metrics behind it. Useful before executing a timing-sensitive transaction. Paid: $0.002 per call via x402.

tools.name: get_recommended_priority_fee_solana
tools.description: Recommends a Solana transaction priority fee based on recent network activity, at low/medium/high confidence levels. Paid: $0.002 per call via x402.

tools.name: store_object
tools.description: Uploads a small base64-encoded object to S3-compatible storage. ~$1/GB, $0.01 minimum, capped at 4MB (larger files: use HTTP PUT /store instead). Returns a key for retrieve_object.

tools.name: retrieve_object
tools.description: Retrieves a stored object by key, base64-encoded. Flat $0.01 per call. Objects over 4MB must be fetched via HTTP GET /retrieve instead.
